description:
About Intellistack

At Intellistack, we're committed to revolutionizing the way organizations collect information, automate workflows, and create seamless digital experiences.

Founded with the belief that work should be simplified, Intellistack has grown into a leading provider of powerful, no-code productivity solutions that help teams do more with less. Across thousands of organizations worldwide, our tools and platform empower users to quickly build custom forms, automate document generation, capture eSignatures, and streamline data-driven processes—all without needing to write a single line of code.

With intuitive solutions that put power in the hands of everyday users, we make it easier to build, automate, and optimize processes at scale.

Who We Are
At Intellistack, we don’t do status quo. We move fast, think deep, and build what’s next—powered by people, supercharged by AI.

We’re a team of builders: curious, driven, and relentless about solving the real problem. Around here, feedback is fuel, clarity wins, and change is the default setting. If you’re hungry to grow and ready to leave a dent, you’ll fit right in.

Who You Are:

  • You’re an exceptional communicator who can gracefully break down, solve, and explain complex problems in a way customers can understand.

  • You’re curious and eager to learn. You might not know all the answers, but you’re willing to find them.

  • You’re comfortable with technology, adapt easily to change, and can switch gears quickly to adjust your priorities and focus.

  • You’re well organized, accurate, and attentive to detail, with an interest in numbers, billing, and helping customers.

What You’ll Do:

You’ll support our customers on the front lines by handling basic billing inquiries and daily billing tasks with care, accuracy, and timely follow-through. Working under the direction of the Billing Manager and closely with the Accounting Team, you’ll help customers resolve billing issues, keep account information accurate, and support internal documentation and projects as requested.

How You’ll Succeed:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for incoming basic billing support requests via email, chat, and/or scheduled phone support.

  • Perform daily billing tasks, including preparing refunds and credits, issuing invoices, processing customer account changes, responding to billing inquiries, and helping customers update billing information.

  • Ensure customer contact information on file is accurate and up to date.

  • Troubleshoot electronic payment failures and work to resolve them.

  • Complete customer vendor setup requirements, including providing basic company and banking information.

  • Meet or exceed established customer inbound ticket quotas while managing and resolving requests in a timely and professional manner.

  • Assist with maintaining written and/or video documentation for internal billing processes and procedures, as requested by management, with a focus on non-Intake processes.

  • Provide project support as requested by management.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 1–3 years of experience in a customer service role.

  • Working or foundational knowledge of billing concepts, particularly SaaS billing and subscriptions.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and concisely.

  • Strong organization, accuracy, and attention to detail.

  • The ability to multitask, manage multiple deadlines, prioritize assignments, and adjust to changing needs.

  • The ability to work effectively within a remote team and collaborate across teams.

  • Working skills in billing, technology, product knowledge, data analysis, using tools and technology, and problem solving.

  • Foundational awareness of accounting, business concepts, processes and operational workflows, and cross-team collaboration.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with Salesforce, Zuora, ZenDesk or other billing and ticketing systems.

Salary Range:

$55,000–$60,000 (USD) per year + bonus up to 5% of base salary

This is a remote position that will be working Mountain or Pacific Hours.

Intellistack is an equal opportunity employer, passionately committed to equitable hiring and boldly dedicated to diversity in our work and teams. We do not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, uniformed service member status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds — especially women, people of color (including bilingual and bicultural individuals), LGBTQ+ persons, and people with disabilities — to apply. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, you might be the right candidate for this or other roles.
